section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the concept of general cognitive ability at both individual and team levels, highlighting its positive relationship with performance, especially in novel and complex tasks. It proposes that higher cognitive ability facilitates adaptation to unforeseen changes and moderates the relationship between team goal difficulty and role structure adaptation. Two hypotheses are presented regarding these relationships.
